security: Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share
footnote_text: Hercules Holding II ("Hercules") holds 32,282,889 shares of Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share ("Shares"), of HCA Healthcare, Inc. (the "Issuer"). Hercules is held by a private investor group, including affiliates of HCA Inc. founder Dr. Thomas F. Frist Jr. The Reporting Person may be deemed to exercise voting and investment control over the Shares held by Hercules, but disclaims beneficial ownership of such Shares except to the extent of her pecuniary interest therein, which may be deemed to include indirect interests in Shares through ownership of Hercules partnership units to the extent of: 357,510 Shares by the Reporting Person; 84,306 Shares by the Reporting Person's spouse; and 9,832,500 Shares by trusts for the benefit of the Reporting Person's children of which the Reporting Person or her spouse is trustee. || On November 4, 2026, the Reporting Person transferred a total 47,002 units of Hercules to trusts for the benefit of the Reporting Person's children of which the Reporting Person or her spouse is trustee in satisfaction of obligations owed by the Reporting Person (with respect to 20,191 units) and in exchange for assets of equal value (with respect to 26,811 units), and trusts for the benefit of the Reporting Person's children of which the Reporting Person or her spouse is trustee transferred a total of 839,869 units of Hercules to trusts for the benefit of the Reporting Person's children of which the Reporting Person or her spouse is trustee in satisfaction of obligations. Each of these transfers was made at a price per unit of Hercules equal to $503.525 (the average of the high and low prices of the Shares on November 4, 2026). In each case, these transfers did not change the total number of Shares of which the Reporting Person may be deemed to have beneficial ownership.
